title: Hadrian button
description: A square, uppercase mono button: a 1px outline on the page colour that takes a faint wash on hover, or a solid gold block with black text that dims a touch. Optional trailing icon (a thin arrow).
notes: a link when given href, otherwise a button
name: hadrian-button

props.name: href
props.description: where it goes; without it the component renders a <button>

props.name: icon
props.description: a small trailing icon, e.g. a thin arrow

props.name: variant
props.description: outline: 1px border on the page colour · solid: a gold block with dark text

props.name: size
props.description: sm: the header's MENU box · md: a compact call to action · lg: full-width hero buttons

props.name: expanded
props.description: for menu toggles: whether what it controls is open

props.name: controls
props.description: for menu toggles: the id of what it opens
